notes: T021-IR-NOTE-01 (non-blocking traceability wording): requirements.md:237-242 (T021-SR-012) states the tap shall expose 'its declared identity, declared route point, declared validity effect, and counters through an exact-handle snapshot'. The snapshot carries only the declared identity and validity effect plus counters; the declared route point is exposed through `ObservationTapSpec::declared_route_point()` (observation.hpp:317-319), not through `ObservationSnapshot`. The requirement's own verification intent and CHK-12 (verification-plan.md:97) enumerate only identity, validity effect, and counters, and architecture.md:143/163 and detailed-design.md section 6 consistently place the route point on the policy. The functional intent (exposing the declared route point, single source of truth) is delivered and verified by `test_declared_tap_binding`; the snapshot omission is a plan-text imprecision, not a capability gap, so it is recorded rather than raised as a blocking finding. A later editorial pass may align T021-SR-012 with CHK-12.

T021-IR-NOTE-02 (non-blocking documentation nuance): the seven new `ObservationFilter` accessors (observation.hpp:229-247) and `ObservationTapSpec::validity_effect()` (observation.hpp:320-321) carry `@brief`/`@return` only, whereas the sibling new accessors `declared_tap_id()`/`declared_route_point()` carry the full `@ownership`/`@lifetime`/`@thread_safety`/`@failure` set. The class-level Doxygen already documents ownership, lifetime, thread-safety, and failure for the immutable value, and the admitted documentation configuration (group `xcom_obs`, strict mode DOX-GAP-01) is unchanged and owned by T011/T037, so this is a consistency nicety rather than a defect.

The `retain` reordering (size/accepted incremented before record construction) is behaviour-neutral: the constructed record reads only the event and policy except for the newly stamped counters, `optional::emplace` cannot fail in the `noexcept` context, and `tail` is computed before the increments. No drop/coalesce/backpressure outcome, ordering, or existing counter changes.

The declared validity effect and the `validityEffect` vocabulary are declared and reported only; `ObservationSnapshot::experiment_validity_degraded` keeps its exact accepted meaning and no degrade/invalidate behavior is applied, correctly leaving T022 (XCOM-SW-OBS-002/003) and T024 (XCOM-SW-OBS-005) unclaimed.
